kali.name: Kali Linux
kali.description: Official Debian-based Kali rolling base image, with an explicit optional headless toolkit provisioning step.
notes: Resolved from docker.io/kalilinux/kali-rolling:latest on 2026-10-17 and verified against Docker Registry API; index supports linux/amd64 and linux/arm64.
The upstream base image contains no default Kali toolkit. Creating this profile does not install kali-linux-headless; provision it explicitly.
The headless metapackage is not every Kali package. GUI, hardware, service and kernel-dependent tools need separate evaluation.
Image pinning freezes the initial filesystem only. Distrobox initialization and explicit APT provisioning use the container's current repositories.

parrot.name: Parrot Security OS
parrot.description: Official Debian-based Parrot Security command-line collection.
notes: Resolved from docker.io/parrotsec/security:latest on 2026-10-17 and verified against Docker Registry API; index supports linux/amd64 and linux/arm64.
Upstream deliberately excludes graphical applications from this image. This is not the complete desktop Security Edition.
The selected tag was last pushed on 2026-05-15. Refreshing the image pin is a reviewed change; it does not track latest silently.
No extra toolkit package is installed by this profile. Distrobox may install its own integration prerequisites during initialization.

remnux.name: REMnux
remnux.description: Official REMnux container based on Ubuntu 24.04 Noble for static analysis and reverse engineering tools.
notes: Resolved from docker.io/remnux/remnux-distro:noble on 2026-10-17 and verified against Docker Registry API; index supports linux/amd64 and linux/arm64.
Upstream excludes VS Code and Wine-dependent tools from the container. Architecture-specific tool availability can differ.
Distrobox shares access with the host and is not a malware detonation sandbox, even with a separate profile home directory.
The stock image assumes a remnux user and home; tools configured specifically there may require adjustment for Distrobox's mapped user.

sift.name: SANS SIFT Workstation
sift.description: Import a root filesystem from a genuine SIFT installation prepared using upstream's supported Ubuntu release.
notes: No current official full SIFT OCI image was verified. The archived teamdfir/sift-dockerfiles repository contains a Salt test image, not a complete workstation.
Upstream currently documents Ubuntu 22.04 and the Cast installer. Do not run that installer against the Ubuntu 26.10 host.
Prepare SIFT separately using upstream instructions, then supply a rootfs tar with its expected SHA-256. An OVA or virtual disk is not itself a rootfs tar.
Imported SIFT compatibility with Distrobox is experimental; its smoke check includes a Sleuth Kit version check, not full forensic validation.

backbox.name: BackBox Linux
backbox.description: Import a root filesystem from the Ubuntu-based BackBox distribution.
notes: No current official full BackBox OCI image was verified. Supply an upstream ISO or an exported rootfs tar with its expected SHA-256.
Import preserves the distribution's user-space packages instead of adding its repositories to the Ubuntu host.
Live desktop startup, GUI tools and services are not guaranteed to work inside Distrobox.
Import support is experimental until the exact artifact has been created and tested on the target WSL host.

caine.name: CAINE
caine.description: Import user-space forensic tools from the Ubuntu-based CAINE distribution.
notes: Upstream distributes CAINE as an ISO and publishes SHA-256 hashes. No current official full CAINE OCI image was verified.
Supply the verified ISO or an exported rootfs tar. A bare Ubuntu container is not a CAINE installation.
CAINE's boot-time write blocking and acquisition guarantees do not carry into a WSL container, which uses the WSL kernel.
Import support is experimental until the exact artifact has been created and tested on the target WSL host.

tsurugi.name: Tsurugi LAB
tsurugi.description: Import user-space tools from Tsurugi LAB, an Ubuntu-based forensic and analysis distribution.
notes: Upstream offers ISO and OVA artifacts and signed SHA-512 hashes. No current official full Tsurugi OCI image was verified.
Verify the upstream signature and checksum before importing the ISO or an exported rootfs tar; retain the resulting artifact SHA-256 for this project's import record.
The Tsurugi custom kernel, device write blocking and acquisition behavior are not provided by a WSL container.
Import support is experimental until the exact artifact has been created and tested on the target WSL host.
